scope: read-only account-credit/quota/promotion qualification for active training campaign

credential_handling.notes: W&B and Fireworks key names occur in local .env, but were not loaded or used in this refresh. Adaption authenticated read-only MCP calls are available. No provider billing tool or account-credit MCP tool is exposed. Prior timestamped account API reads are referenced below.

adaption.status: unavailable from exposed authenticated connector; no remaining balance or SFT/DPO job quote established
adaption.bounded_experiment_implication: No new run has verified credit coverage. The recorded 112-credit/150-minute estimate is for run_dataset_adaptation on the separate 11,192-row arc-run2 dataset, not AutoScientist training and not the 522,658-row v4 dataset. A separate 5-credit/16-minute estimate is for processing the 418-row dataset, which is awaiting input. Neither amount proves available balance or covers a training run. V4-derived training attempts failed before optimizer iteration; account deduction was not exposed, so do not assume zero debit.
adaption.coverage_decision: unverified; do not classify an Adaption SFT/DPO experiment as credit-covered until the dashboard/account view shows remaining amount and an exact run quote or debit estimate for the selected dataset and settings

wandb_inference.status: balance/quota not returned by the authenticated W&B model/inference APIs used in this campaign; official support documentation directs users to the Billing page for credit balance
wandb_inference.bounded_experiment_implication: The latest paired 120-case checkpoint evaluations recorded at 22:50Z have usage estimates of $0.06809825 (v1) and $0.06911325 (v2), $0.13721150 combined; each had a configured preflight maximum of $0.2976, $0.5952 combined. These are experiment estimates/configured caps, not measured credit debits or evidence that the remaining account balance covers another run. Do not authorize further inference from caps alone.
wandb_inference.training_coverage: Existing W&B jobs remain subject to account-specific training price/preview terms; current Training API status/usage routes do not expose billing. Public CoreWeave pricing is not an account charge record. New training cannot be classified as covered from this evidence.

evidence.prior_account_api_finding: docs/training/execution-2026-10-17/provider-qualification.json pricing_refresh_2026_10_19: no account billing portal credential or usage endpoint was available in that audit

wandb_inference.coverage_decision: unverified; individual configured caps bound local runs but do not establish credits or actual billing

current_account_read_only_evidence.plan_limitation: The cookbook computes promotion-active from a local hardcoded deadline and does not query account activation; result is not account-specific entitlement proof.

fireworks.bounded_experiment_implication: Public terms currently advertise eligible Glimmer SFT as free, but this account's activation is not established by a current account response. The public price table separately lists $1.96/M prefill, $4.88/M sample, and $5.86/M train for Serverless Training; do not assume the SFT offer covers in-session sampling or other inference. No sample/token budget is certified here. Muse Glimmer is not available on the serverless inference route per the account qualification; do not plan an external inference arm as covered.
fireworks.coverage_decision: public offer active as published, account-specific application remains unverified; treat SFT coverage as conditional and all sampling/deployment/inference as uncovered absent a separate account quote

cross_provider_conclusion: No exact current credit balance/quota was established for Adaption or W&B, and no Fireworks account-specific promotion activation or balance was established. User-confirmed credits and public offers are not numeric account evidence. No future experiment is proven fully covered; require account evidence and route-specific capped estimates before additional spend.
